Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Equipment isolation which its protection relay under test.

 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Equipment isolation which its protection relay under test.
Tools and Equipment
Current injection 
 device with timer.
Test plug, 
 test leads
Test cabinet.
Work to be Carried Out
Enter the tested relay in the tested 
 cabinet.
I1 and I2 refers to restrain circuit, I0 refers to the 
 differential current.
The direction of current through the restraint circuit should 
 be reversed.
The target operation should be checked by passing 85 
 percent of rated current through the contact circuit.
The relay have three winding (W1.W2.W3)
Inject the current gradually for each winding.
Record the result of tripping current value for each winding.
Compare result reference.
Repeat the test for each phase ( see figure1 
 ).
Return Relay into Service
Return the relay 
 to the panel.
Withdraw the test plug 
 handle from the relay.
Return all connections to the normal position as before 
 the test.
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.
Close the work permit.
